svg.title: Exercise 3e wiring: as Exercise 3d, plus a potentiometer on the breadboard with its wiper on A1
svg.text: The pot (ends to the top + and − rails, wiper to A1) chooses which relay is on: below 2.5 V relay 2 (green), otherwise relay 1 (blue).
The Arduino's 5V and GND feed the top rails (the pot and the relay module); the battery feeds the bottom rails (the LEDs).
